name: Add STAR experimental study, structured arms and first achievement estimate

selected.locator: Table V, column 7, panel A, p. 512

entities.name: Study arm
entities.description: A study-specific group defined by its assigned intervention or comparison condition. Assignment, participation and changes over time must be distinguished.

entities.name: Grade levels
entities.description: School-grade concepts relevant to a record, with the education system identified by each target.

entities.name: Intervention arms
entities.description: Study-specific assigned intervention groups evaluated by an outcome estimate.

entities.name: Comparison arms
entities.description: Study-specific assigned comparison groups used as the reference for an outcome estimate.

entities.name: Kindergarten (United States)
entities.description: The United States school grade preceding first grade.

entities.name: First grade (United States)
entities.description: The first numbered grade in United States elementary education, following kindergarten.

entities.name: Second grade (United States)
entities.description: The second numbered grade in United States elementary education, following first grade.

entities.name: Third grade (United States)
entities.description: The third numbered grade in United States elementary education, following second grade.

entities.name: Tennessee Project STAR
entities.description: A Tennessee experiment that randomly assigned students and teachers within schools to small classes, regular classes, or regular classes with full-time aides.

entities.name: Experimental Estimates of Education Production Functions
entities.description: A published analysis of Tennessee Project STAR’s effects on student achievement, using classroom assignment and observed class size.

entities.name: STAR small-class assignment
entities.description: Initial assignment to a class planned for 13–17 students in Tennessee Project STAR.

entities.name: STAR regular-class assignment with full-time aide
entities.description: Initial assignment to a class planned for 22–25 students with a full-time classroom aide in Tennessee Project STAR.

entities.name: STAR regular-class comparison assignment
entities.description: Initial assignment to a class planned for 22–25 students without a full-time aide in Tennessee Project STAR. Some regular classes had part-time aide access in grades 1–3.

entities.name: STAR class sizes and classroom aides: experimental results (Krueger, 1999)
entities.description: Measured achievement effects from Tennessee’s randomized class-size experiment, organized by grade and assigned classroom condition. Effects are percentile points, with standard errors and source citations.

entities.name: STAR kindergarten: small class assignment effect
entities.description: Initial assignment effect on achievement relative to regular classes without a full-time aide. Standard errors account for within-class correlation; grade-level estimates share participants.
